steps.title: Prepare Lysis Solution
steps.instruction: Add 800 µL of UltraPure™ Distilled Water to a tube (1 per sample).

substeps.instruction: Mix thoroughly by brief pulse vortexing

steps.title: Add Virus Suspension
steps.instruction: Add 200 µL of virus suspension to be extracted to a 1.5 mL tube.

steps.title: Initial Centrifugation
steps.instruction: Centrifuge samples at 12000 rpm, 4 °C, for 15 minutes.

steps.title: Perform Phase Separation
steps.instruction: Add 160 µL of Chloroform to each tube.

substeps.instruction: Incubate for 00:02:00 to 00:03:00 at room temperature

steps.title: Collect Aqueous Phase
steps.instruction: Carefully remove 480 µL of the clear upper aqueous phase and transfer it to a new, labeled microcentrifuge tube.

substeps.instruction: Extract 80% of the aqueous RNA layer, leaving 20% behind to prevent contamination

steps.title: Precipitate RNA
steps.instruction: Add 400 µL of UltraPure™ Distilled Water and 1 µL of UltraPure™ Distilled Water co-precipitant to the aqueous phase.

steps.title: Wash RNA Pellet
steps.instruction: Carefully discard the supernatant and wash the pellet with 800 µL of 75% (v/v) Ethanol.

substeps.instruction: Note: A dark blue RNA pellet should be visible if GlycoBlue was used

steps.title: Remove Ethanol
steps.instruction: Discard the supernatant and remove residual ethanol.

substeps.instruction: Briefly centrifuge to collect residual ethanol
Use a P200 pipette tip to remove remaining ethanol without disturbing the pellet
Vacuum or air dry the RNA pellet for 00:05:00 (do not let the pellet dry completely)

steps.title: Resuspend RNA
steps.instruction: Resuspend the RNA pellet in 50 µL of UltraPure™ Distilled Water by vortexing.
